origin.eidolon_origins.lych.name: Lich
power.eidolon_origins.lych/general/telep: You spawn in Eidor Crypt structure.
power.eidolon_origins.lych/general/fragi: You`re naturally more fragile than normal human being, so you have only 5 hearts.
power.eidolon_origins.lych/general/no_ar: The only thing, that suits you - is warlock's clothes.
power.eidolon_origins.lych/general/no_tr: You cannot talk to living creatures, and therefore you cannot trade with the villagers, and also iron golems are aggressive towards you.
power.eidolon_origins.lych/general/silve: Because you`re undead, you cannot hold silver items.
power.eidolon_origins.lych/general/ash.d: Enchanted ash is dangerous against you. You cannot step on it, and if you touch it or break it you will burn.
power.eidolon_origins.lych/general/damag: All source of damage do more damage against you, expect for magic.
power.eidolon_origins.lych/general/no_ho: You cannot use any holy items.
power.eidolon_origins.lych/general/neutr: Undead enemies are neutral towards you.
power.eidolon_origins.lych/general/codex: From the beginning of the game, you have the codex.
power.eidolon_origins.lych/general/chaos: You know the sign of chaos from the beginning of the game.
eidolon_origins.codex.page.chaos_sign: The sign known only to the Lich. Chaos sing symbolizes true darkness. As a component of chants, it is used to distort, corrupt chants and their meaning. Allowing a Lich to commit crimes against existence itself.
eidolon.codex.page.mage_holders.title: Keepers of Magic
eidolon_origins.codex.page.origins.title: Origins
eidolon_origins.poor_reputation: You cannot talk with living creatures
eidolon_origins.mod_description: Eidolon Origins - an origin mod based on Eidolon, developed by Flamin-go team. Adds lich origin - undead entity, that has a lot of unique magical spells.
